# Cantum Studio

> Cantum Studio adalah studio pembuatan website yang berbasis di Bogor, Jawa Barat, Indonesia. Kami merancang dan membangun website company profile, website portofolio, landing page, toko online, redesain website, serta optimasi SEO dan kecepatan website untuk klien di Bogor, Jabodetabek, dan seluruh Indonesia.

Cantum Studio is a web design and development studio based in Bogor, West Java, Indonesia. We design and build fast, well-crafted, search-friendly websites (company profiles, portfolios, landing pages and online stores) for clients in Bogor, Greater Jakarta and across Indonesia.

## Fakta singkat
- Nama: Cantum Studio
- Bidang: pembuatan website, web design, web development, SEO
- Lokasi: Bogor, Jawa Barat, Indonesia
- Wilayah layanan: Bogor, Depok, Jakarta, Bekasi, Tangerang, seluruh Indonesia (remote)
- Bahasa: Indonesia, English
- Website: https://cantum-studio.site
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/cantumstudio/
